notes.title: v1.2 Update
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751171/1fe3b67c3e48b92f6c4ba617d8d9706a36de2dec.jpg"]

Update 1.2 is live!

This update adds a couple requested features, quality-of-life improvements, and some cleanup behind the scenes.
[p align="start"]**What's new:**
[p align="start"]- The addition of an instant-restart hotkey for speedrunners!  You can set the binding in the control setup
[p align="start"]- You can now add lava to your custom levels!

notes.title: v1.1 Update
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751171/1fe3b67c3e48b92f6c4ba617d8d9706a36de2dec.jpg"]

\Update 1.1\ is live! 

This update adds a few requested features, quality-of-life improvements, and some cleanup behind the scenes.

\**What's new:**\

- You can now jump during a dash

- You can now jump after falling off a ledge

- Level timer now stops immediately when you enter a door in Story Mode

- Music will now shift mid-level if you're taking too long

- Masks now show which season they unlock in

- Cutscenes now auto-advance

- Fixed an issue with selecting random mask

- Updated resolution settings for better compatibility

- Removed some cheaters from the leaderboards
